Purpose
-------
Update or create `docs/VISION.md` with repository-specific vision content. This instruction set prefers interactive editing by the operator.

Prerequisites
-------------
- Local clone with `origin` set and push access.
- `git` available. PowerShell recommended on Windows. A text editor (Notepad, VS Code, etc.) accessible from command line.

Dry-run (preview)
-----------------
```powershell
git fetch origin --prune
if (-Not (Test-Path docs\VISION.md)) { Write-Host "No docs/VISION.md found; will create when applying." } else { Get-Content docs\VISION.md -TotalCount 40 }
```

Interactive apply (recommended)
------------------------------
This mode opens `docs/VISION.md` in the user's editor for interactive editing. After you save and close the editor, the script commits and pushes the change.

```powershell
# Use VISION_TEXT env to apply non-interactively
if ($env:VISION_TEXT) {
  if (-not (Test-Path docs)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path docs | Out-Null }
  $env:VISION_TEXT | Out-File -Encoding utf8 docs\VISION.md
  git add docs\VISION.md
  git commit -m "chore: update docs/VISION.md" || Write-Host "No changes to commit"
  git push origin HEAD
  return
}

# Interactive edit: open editor and wait for user to finish
if (-not (Test-Path docs)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path docs | Out-Null }
if (-not (Test-Path docs\VISION.md)) {
  @"
# Vision

> Describe the repository vision here.
"@ | Out-File -Encoding utf8 docs\VISION.md
}

Write-Host "Opening docs\VISION.md in Notepad. Edit, save and close when done."
notepad docs\VISION.md

Read-Host "Press Enter after you have saved and closed the editor"

git add docs\VISION.md
git commit -m "chore: update docs/VISION.md" || Write-Host "No changes to commit"
git push origin HEAD
```

Notes
-----
- This skill intentionally edits only `docs/VISION.md` and will not create or modify other `VISION.md` files in the repo.
 - If your repo's primary branch is not `main`, create or switch to the appropriate branch before running the instructions.
